description:
FILED s531a (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-01) from #1688 (s531a) -- comp/require.t rows 1742 1743 1746 1747 (the Demo1..Demo4 matrix, lines ~520-580).

PCL (s531a): Parser2 emits (p-unit-module-true) when module_true is in force at the END of the file (Pl::Parser::feature_regions_of / feature_at at [9e8,0]); %p-unit-result answers 1 for such a unit, else a top-level return's value, else the wrapped last statement, else true for (p-unit-value-assumed).
perl: a top-level `return` answers by the module_true hint AT THE RETURN (Demo2: `use feature 'module_true'; ... return 0 if $main::test_mode == 2; ... no feature 'module_true';` -> require answers 1); falling off the end answers by the hint at the end; and a last statement whose CL value PCL does not trust (a statement-modifier if/unless, a bare block) is assumed TRUE where perl reads its real value (Demo4: the last run statement is `{ no feature 'module_true'; return 0 if $main::test_mode == 3 }`, the modifier does not fire, the value is false -> perl dies "did not return a true value", PCL answers true).

FIX SHAPE: (1) a top-level `return` in a module unit is emitted with the module_true state AT ITS SITE; (2) give a statement-modifier if/unless and a bare block their perl value (the condition's value when the modifier does not fire; the block's last statement), so fewer statements need (p-unit-value-assumed) -- the same values a sub's implicit return gets wrong today (`sub f { 5 unless 1 }` returns 1 in perl, undef in PCL).  Probes: s531a scratch/s531a/pr/mt2.pl (E7 E13 edges).

=== DONE (s532b) ===
FIXED per the task's FIX SHAPE.  (1) A top-level `return` of a module unit (outside every sub) is emitted (p-unit-return T-OR-NIL FORM) with the module_true state AT ITS SITE (Pl::Parser::feature_at at the return's location; perl: op.c op_convert_list sets OPf_SPECIAL, pp_leaveeval reads it); %p-unit-result reads that mark, a return the emitter did not mark (a v1-lowered comma return) keeps the end-of-file state.  Falling off the end keeps the end-of-file state: perl reads the LAST top-level nextstate, and a trailing use/no makes that the end's (block_end's parsed_sub nulled nextstate) -- equivalent.  (2) A module unit's LAST segment is lowered in TAIL position ('inherit', as eval mode) and its last run form is wrapped (p-unit-value ...) whatever its head -- the sub-body tail machinery, which already gave subs perl's value (`sub f { 5 unless 1 }` is 1 in PCL too: probed, scratch/s532b/pr/p4168sub.pl); so a modifier, a bare block, an if/unless compound carry perl's value (MtB MtC MtD MtF MtG MtM MtN, the Demo matrix 1-4: all = perl).  Module-mode emission over lib/ + the 30 board dists' lib/ (390 .pm, scratch/s532b/modab.pl): IDENTICAL but Getopt/Long.pm's detector-table nondeterminism.  Residue FILED #4281 (a while/until loop's tail value is the condition's last value, subs and modules alike).  Guard Pl/t/require-value-01.t row 6 (the Demo matrix + eight tail shapes).


=== COMPLETED (s535, reviewing session): merged in MAIN-READY-71 4748a7f5 (s532b); review probes perl -> main -> tree identical. ===
subject: module_true is decided at the END of the file only: a top-level `return 0` under `use feature 'module_true'` answers 0 when the file ends with `no feature 'module_true'` (perl: 1, the hint at the return site); an opaque last statement is assumed true where perl dies
